headline: Apricorn Earns FIPS 140-3 Level 3 Validation for Aegis Secure Key 3.0
summary: Apricorn, the leading global provider of quantum-resistant hardware-encrypted external storage solutions, today announced that its Aegis Secure Key 3.0 (ASK3) has achieved FIPS 140-3 Level 3 validation (Certification #5517) through the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Cryptographic Module Validation Program (CMVP). headline: Solar Stocks Are Splitting Into Two Different Trades
summary: Solar market splits: infrastructure names (GEV, NEE, AES) gain as utility/electrification plays, while hardware pure plays (FSLR, NXT) tumble.
